assets.name: simple-closed
assets.note: Small clean closed control mesh — the sanity baseline. Any quality regression here is a real one, not an artifact of ugly input.

assets.name: anime-girl
assets.note: Dense (~74k vert, coarsened from 390k) Meshy-style character — the headline dense-organic target. Runs the Tier-9 field-aligned pre-remesh (the --solve decimation's successor) to stay tractable; pre-remesh-target matches the old decimation edge length.
